name: DiseaseSpecificResearch
summary: The card component of Disease Specific Research (DUO_0000007). It reads ProjectMembershipCredential, IntendedDataUseCredential and AgreementCredential, compares them with its policy data, and outputs the DownloadGrantCredential that Grant download takes.

allowedDiseases.description: MONDO disease codes the owner allows. An IntendedDataUseCredential qualifies if any entry of claims.useOnlyFor.diseases is in this list.
